text:
Anya: Quick design check — on an iPhone SE the console sidebar is hard to open with the tiny swipe target and the models table overflows horizontally into the viewport. screenshots attached. Thoughts?

Jess (Design): Definitely seeing this. For <420px we should consider a bottom nav + modal drawer for the main sidebar. Swipe target needs to be at least 20-24px wide. Also thinking stacked list cards instead of a dense table under 360px.

Mike L: Agree on swipe area. Also we currently don't prevent body scroll when the sidebar slides over which feels janky. Need a focus trap so keyboard+screen-reader users don't tab into background. Quick CSS note:

```css
/* rough */
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .sidebar-drawer { width: 92%; right: 0; }
  body.sidebar-open { overflow: hidden; position: fixed; width: 100%; }
}
```

Sam (Frontend): Table overflow: two options I prefer: 1) horizontal scroll with sticky first column + clear fade on the right, or 2) convert each row into a stacked card with key fields on top and 'Details' chevron. Stacked cards reduce cognitive load on small screens. Performance note: avoid rendering large tables as cards if there are thousands of rows — need virtualization.

Olivia: For the metrics table the quick filters need to remain visible. If we go cards, keep a sticky compact filter bar at the top. Also copy tweak: change "Show rows" to "Rows per page" for clarity on mobile.

Jess (Design): Accessibility nits: hit target sizes (44px recommended by iOS a11y), ensure 3:1 contrast for disabled states, and don't hide action verbs behind icon-only buttons on mobile. For the sidebar modal, add aria-modal and role="dialog".

Mike L: Another small UX thing — when collapsing columns we should preserve the primary action in the right-most sticky area (e.g., Run / Stop) so it's always reachable with one thumb.

Sam (Frontend): Implementation idea for table truncation: show 1 line with ellipsis and a subtle "more" affordance that expands inline. Avoid full page nav for small expansions.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist: https://a11y-checks.internal/recommended (posted) :white_check_mark:

Anya: Love the concrete options. Plan: Jess will update Figma with two variants (cards + horizontal scroll) and breakpoints at 420px and 360px. Sam/Mike to prototype the focus trap + body lock. Olivia will confirm copy change. I'll schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Jess (Design): Added a tiny mock for the bottom nav pattern in the figma file (link in thread). Please comment on spacing and whether we keep the account avatar in the footer. :eyes:

Olivia: Quick vote — keep avatar (helps support flows). +1

Mike L: I'll PR a small util to lock body scroll and a reusable Drawer component. ETA EOD.

Sam (Frontend): I'll follow up on virtualization perf if we go cards.

Anya: Thanks everyone — will post the updated mocks and the decision doc after the sync.
